name: Spondylodiscitis - Pyogenic
definition: Bacterial infection of an intervertebral disc and adjacent vertebral endplates, sometimes complicated by epidural or paraspinal infection.

investigations.principle: Blood cultures and inflammatory markers plus contrast MRI are central to diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Biopsy or surgery is selected when diagnosis is unclear, instability or neural compression exists.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Any Shotha/Asthi-Majja framework is secondary to antimicrobial care.

patientEducation.summary: Bacterial infection of an intervertebral disc and adjacent vertebral endplates, sometimes complicated by epidural or paraspinal infection.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
